title: Outstanding Undergraduate Student Award
description: Recognized by the TXST Mathematics Department for academic achievement, contributions to the department, serving as President of the Math Club, and delivering departmental talks.

title: MAA Math Bowl 2nd Runner-Up (Team TXST)
imageAlt: MAA Math Bowl second runner-up team award
description: MAA Math Bowl (Second Runner-Up): Represented Texas State University at the 105th Annual Mathematical Association of America Regional Conference at Baylor University and competed against 25 teams.

title: Dean's / President's List
description: Recognized for outstanding academic performance at Texas State University by being named to the Dean's List. Achieved a perfect 4.0/4.0 GPA multiple semesters, placing among the top students for academic excellence.

title: RMF Bias Analysis Recognition
description: Recognized for presenting and analyzing bias-focused RMF results with clear methodology and communication.

title: President's Honor Scholarship
description: Issued by Texas State University in recognition of outstanding academic credentials. The scholarship provides $48,000 over four years.

title: Calculus Bee Champion (TXST)
imageAlt: Calculus Bee Champion at Texas State University
description: Won the Texas State University Calculus Bee through fast and accurate problem solving.

title: Named BOSS Scholar
description: Recipient of multiple scholarships, including the Lullene and Anderson Family Association Scholarship, Merry Kontz Honors College Scholarship, Student Government Scholarship, and Department of Mathematics Scholarship.

title: Award Nominations
description: Nominated for Rising Star Student Employee and the TSUS Regents Scholar Award in recognition of academic leadership, service, and student impact.
